description: Paid: sum RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0); RLUSD only. Pay per call, solves one question: Return up to 5 Agent Weather readings in one call. Price = sum of selected component list prices. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: batch_readings
